chapter_theme: The swallowing of the universe (விசுவக் கிராசம்): the body dissolves into the Supreme like a bubble or camphor in fire, and Siva, who spreads through all and eats and spits out the world, draws soul, Supreme, turiya and cosmos into himself, as heated iron draws in water or a wood-apple is emptied while its shell stays whole.

2587.reading: Like the shadow-man who vanishes, like a bubble on flowing water, like camphor in a rising flame, this streaming body goes into that Supreme.
2587.nuance: The three images are of disappearance without remainder: camphor in fire leaves no ash. சாயாபுருடன் (shadow-man) is taken as one's shadow, or as the shadow-figure some yogic texts describe; the plain sense holds either way. The body's ending is framed as merging into the Supreme, not as mere loss.

2588.reading: When body and soul become wholly one, Siva-Shakti spreading through them is itself the Supreme; the soul, leaving the body, becomes everywhere, and end and beginning vanish in Siva.
2588.nuance: ஒழிவற ஒன்றில் (become one without remainder) may describe the union of body and soul in the yogi or their joint absorption. கடையுந் தலையும் (end and head) may be the ends of time or the soul's lowest and highest states.

2589.reading: The senses joined in ear, body, mouth, eyes and nose, and the five beginning with mind, unextinguished, without contracting, expanding and contracting, are themselves the moving and unmoving world without end.
2589.nuance: The verse seems to say that the soul's senses and inner faculties, in the swallowed state, are no longer its own but the whole world (சராசரம்). மனம் ஆதிகள் ஐந்து is unusual; the inner instruments are usually counted four. The reading is a guess.

2590.reading: The Supreme stands spread fully everywhere, strong everywhere and dense everywhere; mighty everywhere, he eats the world and spits it out; this is how I saw the gift and came to live.
2590.nuance: உலகு உண்டு உமிழ்க்கும் (eats and spits out the world) gives dissolution and emanation as one act, the chapter's swallowing. The last line turns to the speaker's experience.

2591.reading: Measuring and drawing in the knowledge that is in turiya, discarding the world the mind had taken in, if one reaches the risen Supreme Siva, one becomes the open space itself.
2591.nuance: வெட்டவெளி (open space) is a term for the formless Supreme. பரஞ்சகம் உண்டது may mean 'what the world has eaten' or 'the world eaten by the mind'; the sense of discarding the world is clear.

2592.reading: Drawing me in as heated iron draws in water, going beyond even the highest Supreme, swallowing the light of the three voids to gain strength, my Nandi stayed in my heart.
2592.nuance: இரும்பிடை நீர் (water on hot iron) is a classic image of total absorption: the water vanishes into the iron. முப்பாழ் (the three voids) is a technical term, traditionally the voids of maya, of the soul and of the Supreme, but the verse does not say.

2593.reading: Like the wood-apple fruit eaten by the elephant, Lord Siva swallows, so that they spin, the soul, the Supreme, the Siva spoken of before, the rare turiya and the world above, all of it.
2593.nuance: கரியுண் விளவின் கனி is the wood-apple that keeps its shell while its inside is gone, said to happen when an elephant swallows it whole or when a blight called கரி strikes it. Sengalvaraya notes the image in Civaka Cintamani 1122 and Tiruppugazh 57. The point is that all remains in outward form while its substance is taken into Siva. திரிய (whirling) is unclear.

2594.reading: The highest of the high, who is end and beginning, the supreme beyond the supreme in himself, with the Supreme, swallowed us, and Nandi stayed at the end of what is known in true knowledge; we do not know it.
2594.nuance: நேயாந்தம் is taken as jneya-anta, the end of the knowable. நாம் அறியோமே (we do not know) may mean that the swallowed self no longer knows as a separate knower, or simply that the state is beyond knowing.

links.note: Both see the body as a bubble. The Naladiyar's wise draw from it the resolve to end their births; Tirumular sets the bubble beside camphor in fire and has the body go into the Supreme.
2590 says the Supreme eats the world and spits it out again; 2593 says what is swallowed, soul, Supreme, turiya and the cosmos, and that it stays outwardly whole like the emptied wood-apple.

source_issues: 2589: மனம் ஆதிகள் ஐந்தும் is unusual, since the inner instruments are usually four; a word may be lost or the count is Tirumular's own.
